bibl.title: The Throw of Isis-Aphrodite: A Rare Decorated Knucklebone from the Metropolitan Museum of New York.
bibl.seg: Ada Nifosi, The Throw of Isis-Aphrodite: A Rare Decorated Knucklebone from the Metropolitan Museum of New York.
bibl.note: Introduction. - Knucklebones in Graeco-Roman Egypt: Orphic rituals involving knucklebones?; - Decorated artificial knucklebones from Graeco-Roman Egypt; - Romano-Egyptian oracular dice with names of Egyptian deities. - The Iconography of the Metropolitan Museum knucklebone: Plantar Side: "Baubo" Figure of Isis-Aphrodite; - Medial Side: Eros; - Lateral side: Ganymedes or Kronos (in association with Harpocrates). - Conclusions.
